proposals.name: 01_electrica
proposals.banner_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished YouTube banner, wide landscape 16:9 image. Brand: Te Lo Explico En Short, a Spanish short-form channel about absolutely any topic. Art direction: acid yellow and nearly black, bold condensed grotesk typography, punchy independent culture magazine identity. Avatar emblem is a chunky black lowercase 'e' with a yellow lightning shaped cut. Flat ink, strong confident composition. Sophisticated authored graphic identity, compelling oversized custom typography with careful kerning, dynamic but disciplined layout, visually striking. Exact text: "TE LO EXPLICO" on first line, "EN SHORT" on second line, and small "@TeLoExplicoEnShort" below. Keep ALL lettering and the small emblem contained inside the central 58% width and central 27% height of the canvas, readable YouTube mobile safe area. Use the outer canvas for large cropped abstract graphic shapes and expressive scale that complement center. Full bleed background. Do not show topics, category lists, topic icons, objects, mockups, frames, gradients, AI sparkle patterns or additional text. This is final banner art, not a brand presentation.
proposals.profile_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. One single large emblem only, centered with generous 18% outer margin for circular cropping, no written channel name, no handle, no border, no extra decorations. Strong graphic silhouette instantly readable at 48px. Full bleed solid colored background matching the described brand palette. Finished professional brand mark.
